Since each dinner selection requires exactly one appetizer and one main course, the number of different dinner combinations is the product of the number of appetizers and the number of main courses. A pizza has 12 slices and each slice contains 220 calories. A tray of cookies has 8 cookies and each cookie contains 270 calories. How many more calories does the pizza have than the tray of cookies? The pizza contains 12 slices with 220 calories each. Thus the pizza contains 12 * 220 = 2640 calories. The tray of cookies has 8 cookies with 270 calories each. Thus the tray of cookies has 8 * 270 = 2160 calories. The difference between the two amounts to 2640 - 2160 = 480. Thus the pizza has \boxed{480} more calories than the tray of cookies.
